{{Description|This Remnant Creature living inside the Sonoro Sphere of Honami City was said to have been the city's mascot before its destruction. The original "Namipon" was initially conceived as a municipal transit mascot that safeguard citizens' daily commutes, moving at supersonic speeds between urban railroad tracks. Later on, it gradually evolved into a mascot encompassing various aspects of the city.|Glossary Excerpt}}
'''Namipon''' {{Lang|ja=ナミポン}} is an [[NPC]] in [[Chronorift Metropolis]] and can be found in [[Shashou Cafe]]. Prior to its destruction, Namipon was the mascot of [[Honami City]], and now declares itself the "guardian of Honami".

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Namipon}} 

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(After completing {{Quest|Stagnant Dawn on Wastelands}}
:'''Namipon''': Hello again, Passenger!
:{{DIcon|Option}} How’s the cafe now?
::'''Namipon''': All good here! We’ve got everything covered. Don’t worry about a thing.
::'''Namipon''': Whenever you’ve got a moment, just drop by. I’ll have a fresh cup of coffee waiting for you. And I’ll even share my favorite Rice Dango with you…
::'''Namipon''': Oh, and if you can… bring Chisa too. I miss her. She used to carry me through the streets of Honami. Our walks were always so much fun…
::'''Namipon''': Passenger, the time we spent together… no matter how many times I think back on it, it always feels special. The kind of memory you want to hug close under your pillow forever.
:{{DIcon|Option}} How’s Honami City now?
::'''Namipon''': Still not totally normal. There’s some Lament energy hanging around. But thanks to all of you, the people’s leftover Longings all drifted up into the sky that night.
::'''Namipon''': Like tiny stars tucked into colorful bubbles, they blew away with the wind, carried to the edge of the sky where the light is.
::'''Namipon''': I think they made it to a better place… Back to the ones they loved most. No regrets left behind. Because every story deserves a gentle, wholesome ending. 
:{{DIcon|Option}} How are you doing?
::'''Namipon''': I’m good. Really good, mhmm! Just the other day, I made a Rice Dango all by myself! The shape was… well, not good. But it was sweet and yummy!
::'''Namipon''': Chisa used to make them for me, but now I can do it too. You should try one next time!
::{{DIcon}} Do you want to explore the outside world with me, Namipon?
::'''Namipon''': Aw, an invitation like that really makes me happy… But I can’t leave this city.
::'''Namipon''': I was born because of Honami, and I’ll stay here to the very end. This is my home. Even if it means reliving the same loop forever… I’d still  be happy.
::'''Namipon''': You can come back anytime, Passenger. I’ll keep the coffee warm and the Rice Dangos soft. This place will always welcome your arrival.
{{Dialogue End}}
